During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''crisis''' struck the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], when fallen [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Parkanas Tark]], in his persona of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Vivicar, possessed by the spirit of the Sith [[Terrak Morrhage]], utilized the [[Dark Plague]] disease to corrupt the minds of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] across the galaxy. The conflict was resolved thanks to the efforts of a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], who used the ancient [[shielding technique]] to save Vivicar's victims and ultimately redeem Tark.
